brief: Further avatar explorations beyond simple geometric heads, folded loops and device modules; approved UI and larger readable size retained.

directions.name: Sculpted Visages
directions.summary: Abstract sculpted faces with noses, cheeks and distinctive expressions
directions.prompt:
Use case: UI avatar art direction / precise avatar replacement.
The owner likes the pearl/fluid Hermes Studio interface and larger, clear avatars, but wants options FURTHER AWAY from simple rounded geometric creatures, folded loops and little robot modules. Create the new individual identity system below. This is an AVATAR exploration, not an interface redesign.
INPUT: desktop+phone approved pearl/fluid interface with an avatar identity strip beneath, EDIT TARGET. Preserve all UI geometry, reading content, whitespace, translucent surfaces, soft pearl/blue/amber lighting, thin regular typography, pill composer, point cloud and desktop/phone arrangement. Replace ALL previous avatar artwork in the sidebar, Echo message row, phone message row and bottom identity strip. Do not leave any old folded emblems behind.
OUTPUT: landscape 3:2 with the SAME format as Input: large desktop and phone UI across the upper ~76%, clean white identity strip across the bottom ~24%. The strip shows four large finished avatars labelled Atlas, Nova, Scout, Echo, each with a small matching UI-size sample. Small family number/name at the edge. Main point is testing these avatars INSIDE the approved interface at the already-enlarged size, as well as examining the designs below.
SIZE/LEGIBILITY: keep the generous avatar size of Input, approximately 52–56px sidebar and 44–48px message design targets; visible artwork fills 85–90% of the frame. Do not shrink into a small object in a large white ring. Strong opaque silhouette and clear color masses, legible across the room. No fine line engraving, busy texture, flimsy strokes, pale low-contrast figures or decorative noise. Every identity must differ in OUTLINE and INTERNAL DESIGN, not only color.
FOUR NAMES/COLOR ANCHORS: Atlas / Chief of staff = vivid cobalt/azure blue; Nova / Creative partner = vivid coral/vermilion red; Scout / Research analyst = deep vivid emerald/teal green; Echo / Writing partner = golden yellow/amber. Colors may have a second related darker tone for depth. Repeat each name's exact identity consistently in sidebar, message row, phone and bottom strip. All Echo portraits are the new yellow/amber identity, not an old loop.
ABSOLUTELY NO ROKI: no rock, faceted hood, recessed robot face with glowing eyes, side orange insert, shoes, stone or crystal material. No plants, fish, animal scenes, photoreal people, unrelated character posters or generic stock icons. No miniature bodies, props, hands or sneakers. This new set must feel original and deliberately different from the prior geometric-head/robot systems.
Do not append the old avatars or paste in a reference sheet. Actually replace them throughout the working interface and present the four new designed identities in the bottom strip. Keep all non-avatar UI content intact. Add a small unobtrusive "Design preview" outside the UI.
FAMILY 01 / SCULPTED VISAGES.
Original abstract FACE RELIEFS, like finely designed miniature art objects. Move beyond sticking two oval eyes on a geometric body: use recognisable nose planes, cheeks, expressive asymmetric cutouts and small relaxed mouth lines, with friendly sophisticated facial construction. These are invented contemporary sculptural portraits, not depictions of real people, tribal artifacts or ceremonial cultural masks. No sinister eye holes, angry brows or armored helmets.
Atlas: broad COBALT face relief, clearly rectangular outer contour with softened corners, strong T-shaped nose ridge, calm narrow eyes and an understated friendly mouth line.
Nova: narrow CORAL oval portrait with a sweeping asymmetric cheek curve, one raised curved brow and a small amused expression. Distinct nose/eye spacing from Atlas.
Scout: EMERALD asymmetric face, sloping pentagonal outline, one larger circular eye and a long off-center nose ridge, alert curious expression without scowl.
Echo: GOLDEN AMBER relief made from two subtly mirrored profile planes meeting at a soft central nose, broad horizontal contour and relaxed crescent eyes.
Shallow polished satin relief, broad lighting, strong distinct face silhouettes, slight two-tone color shading. The faces should be expressive mature design portraits, not cute emoji, childish plastic toys or generic cartoon robot masks. No legs or headgear.

FAMILY 02 / CHARACTER TYPE.
LARGE CUSTOM TYPOGRAPHIC IDENTITIES, not characters with eyes or limbs. The four initials themselves ARE the avatars. No surrounding colored badges, no generic font letter pasted on a circle, no emoji face. Bespoke confident variable-font-like glyph sculpture with a subtle shallow satin extrusion and excellent readability.
Atlas = massive COBALT "A": very broad shoulders, softened rounded apex, large clean triangular counter and thick stable legs.
Nova = VERMILION "N": tall narrow architecture, one dramatic smooth flowing diagonal that joins two thick upright strokes.
Scout = EMERALD "S": squared serpentine stroke, compact wide proportions, clearly offset terminals and generous internal negative space.
Echo = GOLDEN AMBER "E": three bold staggered rounded horizontal bars connected by a thick upright; shorter middle bar, broad confident silhouette.
Each glyph fills almost its entire UI avatar frame with enough optical breathing space. Letters must remain unambiguously A, N, S and E even in the smallest samples. Use a related darker inner edge/side shade rather than rainbow texture. These should feel like a sophisticated typographic identity system, not animated alphabet mascots. No faces, shoes, legs or hands.

FAMILY 03 / LAYERED MEDALLIONS.
FACELESS thick STACKED RELIEF EMBLEMS with distinctive outer contours, 2 strong related colors and tactile shadow between at most THREE BIG LAYERS. A miniature identity artifact, not a rounded geometric head, ordinary folded ribbon or generic flat app symbol. No common circular or rounded-square container enclosing all four.
Atlas: COBALT/NAVY STEPPED SHIELD, broad low outer shoulder contour, two inset large stair-step layers and one small bold central blue block.
Nova: CORAL/SCARLET ASYMMETRIC SUNBURST, exactly four broad unequal rounded rays cut as solid relief layers around an offset core. Abstract geometric badge, not a flower.
Scout: EMERALD/TEAL OFFSET COMPASS WEDGE, strong directional outer contour with a layered pointed-but-rounded front and one contrasting inset slash, no thin arrow outlines or tiny compass marks.
Echo: AMBER/ORANGE CONCENTRIC HORSESHOES opening in opposite directions, stacked as thick relief plates with two clear broad counters, giving a horizontally wide silhouette.
Precisely machined satin/resin finish, crisp broad highlights, one restrained shadow per layer. No tiny decoration, engraving, eyes, noses, face panels, shiny chrome glare or historic coat-of-arms detail. Each should be clearly identifiable in monochrome and carry a mature independent personality.

FAMILY 04 / BOLD MOSAIC.
ENTIRELY FLAT GRAPHIC IDENTITY PORTRAITS/INSIGNIA assembled from THREE OR FOUR OVERSIZED COLORED PIECES, like excellent contemporary cut-paper brand design. This direction must be visibly different from all glossy 3D characters. No 3D extrusion, shine, soft sculpted faces, universal rounded-square containers or tiny mosaic tiles. Flat vivid colors, crisp broad silhouettes, a little negative white space and at most one dark contrasting piece.
Atlas: BLUE vertical central slab plus two broad navy shoulder blocks and one small white cutout; a broad stable architectural/totem silhouette.
Nova: CORAL diagonal cross built from two thick orange-red strips and one off-center contrasting red square; dynamic asymmetric silhouette.
Scout: GREEN staircase zigzag made of three large emerald/teal blocks with a contrasting lime top tile; angular directional contour.
Echo: YELLOW alternating DOUBLE-WAVE BLOCKS, two wide interlocking amber and orange stepped curves with one dark golden end segment; wide flowing silhouette.
These are original abstract graphic identities, not literal objects or geometric creatures with eyes. No faces, eyes, body parts, letters, leaves, flowers or photo collage. Strong distinctive poster-grade shape design, visually witty and absolutely readable when small. Preserve the soft pearl UI; only the avatar system adopts this bolder flat graphic language.

refinements.prompt:
Refine ONLY the AVATAR ART STYLE in this Bold Mosaic Hermes Studio concept. Keep the entire interface, all typography, layout, colors of UI/background, bottom-strip labels and avatar placement/size unchanged.
The current avatars still look like extruded 3D blocks. Replace them consistently everywhere — sidebar, Echo message portrait, phone portrait, large bottom artwork and small samples — with TRUE FLAT 2D CUT-PAPER GRAPHICS.
Keep each avatar's core silhouette and palette:
Atlas: one azure vertical rectangle plus two dark-blue broad shoulder slabs, flat frontal geometry.
Nova: two thick coral/vermilion diagonal strips plus one red offset square forming an asymmetric cross.
Scout: three emerald/teal stepped zigzag pieces plus one lime top tile, arranged as a FLAT graphic mark, no visible top or side planes, no isometric block stack.
Echo: two broad interlocking yellow/orange wave pieces as FLAT opaque paper shapes.
No 3D extrusion, rounded volume, bevels, material reflections, cast shadows, specular highlights or gradients INSIDE the avatars. Use only three or four large SOLID FLAT COLOR pieces and crisp negative white space. They should look like an excellent bold vector brand system on paper — completely different from the glossy 3D avatars in the other studies. Do not flatten or recolor the approved glass UI itself. Preserve the enlarged clear avatar silhouettes and text legibility.
